utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still gathering tools and spare parts, so there’s a good chance they’re making a solid list before anything gets fixed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So they’re still just collecting things, not actually fixing anything yet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s what I’ve heard — mostly sorting and collecting right now, not the actual repairs yet. Once they’ve got enough, I bet the fixing will start pretty quickly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I might miss a few updates, so just let me know the plan when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as the plan’s set and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s start with sorting the donations and checking what tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll sort the donations first and make a quick tools list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re low on tape, screws, and a couple of work gloves. If you can bring any of those, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring tape and screws today, and I’ll check for gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line up the repair drive around school pickup and drop-off times. What time window are you aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be perfect — I was hoping for a window that catches both pickup and drop-off. Maybe around 3:00 to 5:30?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work — I’ll aim for 3:00 to 5:30 and make sure it doesn’t clash with pickup. I’ll circle back once I’ve checked the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what time are we starting, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m thinking we start around 10, and if you can bring work gloves plus a couple of basic tools, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 10 sounds good to me. I’ll bring gloves and a couple of basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, we’re kicking off the repair drive soon—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn—I’d appreciate that. I just need to check my schedule and figure out transport first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — just let me know what works, and I’ll hold a spot for you. If transport’s the only snag, I can help you figure that out too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive coming up — what do you know about it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — we’re putting together a neighborhood repair drive to help folks with small fixes around their homes. I’m still finalizing the details, but I can tell you the date and what kinds of repairs we’ll take once I’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great — if you hear the date and repair list, could you let me know? I’d love to pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details again? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I can share them again. What part do you want me to go over first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you start with the date, time, and exact address? Then I’ll make sure I’ve got the rest right too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep it quiet for now. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — if you can stay quiet about it, just let me know what I should bring and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Bring a few basic tools and show up Saturday morning by the old garage. Keep it between us, and I’ll fill you in there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — if the repair drive needs any tools, I’ve got a few I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What tools should I grab first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Start with a hammer, a screwdriver set, and some pliers — those usually cover most fixes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where the repair drive is happening—what location are we using?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s use the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ve got it down: community center parking lot.
